verdict.rationale: A probe confirmed that a machine-readable OpenAPI spec can be downloaded at docs.openhands.dev/openapi.json: it returns HTTP 200 and contains an "openapi" key. This matches the documented HTTP API offered by the Agent Server and the advertised API support for automation. Missing for 10: first-party docs explaining which API the spec covers (Cloud vs. Agent Server) and how it is versioned, and independent hands-on corroboration that the spec is complete and usable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: PROBE openapi: HTTP 200 at https://docs.openhands.dev/openapi.json — contains "openapi" key
The Agent Server package (`openhands-agent-server`) runs the OpenHands Software Agent SDK behind an HTTP and WebSocket API.
API support for automation and scripting
